load_flax_model_from_pretrained: load a pretrained Flax model from the Hugging Face Hub or a local directory using from_pretrained
save_flax_model_pretrained: save a Flax model and its configuration to a directory using save_pretrained
cast_flax_params_to_bf16: cast Flax model parameters to bfloat16 precision using to_bf16 for TPU half-precision training
cast_flax_params_to_fp16: cast Flax model parameters to float16 precision using to_fp16 for GPU half-precision inference
cast_flax_params_to_fp32: cast Flax model parameters back to float32 precision using to_fp32
